test.name: Rerun provider_manifest and provider_interpolation for 10 minutes each after the spec 0023 step 1 validator change

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run runs provider_manifest and provider_interpolation for 600 seconds each, one at a time, on the tree with the native probe branch of validate::probe and the ProbeText and ProbeBoolean interpolation positions, and finds no crash, hang, or out of memory.
actual: no crash, hang, or out of memory in either target and fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input; provider_manifest: 445881 runs in 601 s (741 exec/s), cov 14544, ft 36778, corpus 1885 inputs, peak RSS 440 MB; provider_interpolation: 1181823 runs in 601 s (1966 exec/s), cov 1605, ft 4815, corpus 737 inputs, peak RSS 647 MB. Both ran while other sessions built and fuzzed on the same Mac, so exec/s is lower than the earlier 2026-10-20 record.
steps: after spec 0023 step 1 (commit 06c095c: name and params in RawProbe, the native branch of validate::probe, and the ProbeText and ProbeBoolean interpolation positions) with a clean tree, use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2; the interpolation harness in provider::fuzzing also checks the two new positions (no secret, folder, runtime root, or executable token, and exactly one token for a boolean param)

`cargo xtask fuzz run provider_manifest --time 600` was built and started on 06c095c at about 23:22Z on 2026-10-21; `cargo xtask fuzz run provider_interpolation --time 600` followed at about 23:35Z on f5c1ea8 (spec 0023 step 5), which changes only supervisor code and tests that neither target runs; HEAD when the record was written is 058a9e4, which adds step 6 tests and docs only

start from the committed seeds fuzz/seeds/provider_manifest and fuzz/seeds/provider_interpolation only (fuzz/corpus was empty in this fresh worktree), with -max_len 262144 and 4096 as xtask sets them; the seeds were not regenerated because step 2 (the NATS package change) has not landed yet, so `cargo xtask fuzz seed` runs in that step
check that each command exits 0 with `ran for 600 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input, and read the libFuzzer final stats
the logs live in the session scratchpad and are not kept in this record's folder
